paper.title_en: Learning Effective Bulk Fields from Fermionic Spectra: Application to an Extended Power-Law Liquid Model for Cuprate Strange Metals
paper.abstract_en: We develop a Neural-ODE framework to infer effective bulk metric functions and the charge-weighted gauge potential from boundary fermionic spectra within a static, planar black-hole ansatz. Controlled benchmarks recover the known bulk profiles of the Einstein--Maxwell and Gubser--Rocha models. We then use normalized interaction self-energy targets generated from an extended power-law liquid model with parameters calibrated by angle-resolved photoemission measurements to test the proposed geometric explanation of cuprate strange-metal spectra in a semi-holographic setting. For this application, we use a massless probe in backgrounds with conformal-to-$\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathbb{R}^2$ asymptotics and derive a spectral extraction formula from the conserved radial Dirac flux. We identify coordinate/Weyl redundancy and a degeneracy in the scaled Hawking temperature of the normalized inverse problem. The conformal factor remains undetermined, so bulk entropy and the associated contribution to electronic specific heat require independent input. Low-temperature targets are fitted accurately across the studied doping range. In the high-temperature test, however, the present ansatz and optimization search have not yielded a refined geometry that accurately reproduces the thermal spectral shape while preserving frequency symmetry. These results may guide the further development of semi-holographic models for cuprates, and the framework may also find applications in other strongly correlated electron systems.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在静态平面黑洞拟设下用 Neural-ODE 从边界费米子谱反演有效体度规函数与规范势，并以扩展幂律液体模型检验铜氧化物奇异金属谱的全息解释，属于全息凝聚态物理的核心应用；理论框架明确，含受控基准检验与明确的负结果与简并性讨论，方法严谨性较强。
decision.title_zh: 从费米子谱学习有效体场：应用于铜氧化物奇异金属的扩展幂律液体模型
decision.abstract_zh: 我们发展了一个 Neural-ODE 框架，用以在静态平面黑洞拟设内从边界费米子谱推断有效体度规函数与电荷加权规范势。受控基准测试恢复了 Einstein--Maxwell 与 Gubser--Rocha 模型的已知体轮廓。随后，我们使用由扩展幂律液体模型生成、参数经角分辨光电子能谱测量标定的归一化相互作用自能目标，在半全息设定下检验所提出的对铜氧化物奇异金属谱的几何解释。对于这一应用，我们在具有共形到 $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathbb{R}^2$ 渐近的背景中使用无质量探针，并从守恒的径向 Dirac 通量推导出谱提取公式。我们指出了坐标/Weyl 冗余以及归一化逆问题中标度霍金温度的简并性。共形因子仍未被确定，因此体熵及其对电子比热的相应贡献需要独立输入。低温目标在所研究的掺杂范围内被精确拟合。然而在高温测试中，当前的拟设与优化搜索尚未得到一种精细化的几何，能够在保持频率对称性的同时准确重现热谱形状。这些结果可能指导铜氧化物半全息模型的进一步发展，该框架也可能在其他强关联电子体系中找到应用。
